rows.name:
Ask a child in Frontier Village to tell you why the[XENO:n ]
Nopon Sage is so great.
Talk to Pique in Frontier Village.
Return to the Nopon Sage.
Talk to Pachika in Frontier Village.
Return to the Nopon Sage.

You understand a little better why the[XENO:n ]
Nopon Sage is so great.

You have had to accept the Nopon Sage's challenge.[XENO:n ]
Go to a dangerous place and demonstrate your[XENO:n ]
courage.

Go to the Seahorse Islet in Makna Forest and[XENO:n ]
collect the [System:Color name=item ]Proof of Courage[/System:Color].
Return to the Nopon Sage.

Through your successful completion of this final[XENO:n ]
test the Nopon Sage recognises your courage.

You are to take the Nopon Sage's final test. You[XENO:n ]
must go to a little island at Great Makna Falls and[XENO:n ]
demonstrate your strength.

Go to Great Makna Falls in Makna Forest and[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Unreliable Rezno[/System:Color]. (Only at daytime.)
Return to the Nopon Sage.

You have completed the final test. The Nopon[XENO:n ]
Sage is impressed and gives you a gift.

The broken bridge is causing problems for the Nopon.[XENO:n ]
If they had the materials, they could fix it. Help them[XENO:n ]
by collecting the materials they need to mend it.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Hode Planks[/System:Color] from Hodes in[XENO:n ]
Makna Forest.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Rhogul Axe Crests[/System:Color] from Mist Rhoguls[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to the Nopon in charge of bridge repair.

The bridge has been repaired. The Nopon of[XENO:n ]
Frontier Village are very happy.

There are lots of terrifying monsters in Makna Forest.[XENO:n ]
Clear some of them so the road is safe.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Jungle Quadwings[/System:Color] in Makna Forest.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The road to Frontier Village is a little safer.

There are lots of terrifying monsters in Makna Forest.[XENO:n ]
Defeat some to stop them eating the local Nopon.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Makna Feris[/System:Color] in Makna Forest.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The road to Frontier Village is a little safer.

There are lots of terrifying monsters in Makna Forest.[XENO:n ]
Clear some that attack the Nopon from the air.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Makna Ansels[/System:Color] in Makna Forest.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The road to Frontier Village is a little safer.

There are lots of terrifying monsters in Makna Forest.[XENO:n ]
Clear some of them so the road is safe.
Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Makna Eks[/System:Color] in Makna Forest.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The road to Frontier Village is a little safer.

If the Nopon dare to bathe where the Eks drink water,[XENO:n ]
they're very likely to be attacked by a horrifying[XENO:n ]
monster. Defeat it and let the Nopon wash in safety.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Shimmering Forte[/System:Color] near the Eks Watering[XENO:n ]
Hole in Makna Forest. (On a hot day.)

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The Nopon can wash safely now.

High purity Water Ether Crystals are needed to save[XENO:n ]
a girl. There should be some near the large waterfall.[XENO:n ]
Find some Water Ether Crystals in Makna Forest.
Collect some [System:Color name=item ]Water Ether Crystals[/System:Color].

You found some Water Ether Crystals. These[XENO:n ]
should be able to help save the girl now.
